title: Facile preparation of fluorescent carbon dots from water caltrop shells and their application in amikacin sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7742-7749
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00501A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yi Zhang, Ping Dong, Xin Chen, Jin Wang, Yun Zhang, Bowen Liu
This study developed cost-effective WCS-CDs from water caltrop shells using a simple hydrothermal process. The WCS-CDs demonstrated fluorescence quenching linearly related to AMK concentration for AMK detection in real samples.
